# Calendar

A month grid for picking a date or a range.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-calendar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Calendar examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-calendar--docs">Open Calendar in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-calendar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** A date near today or a range, shown at once, where the day of the week matters. Not a birth date; type it.

- **Use it when:** Dates near today, ranges, or when the day of the week matters.
- **Not when:** A date people know by heart, such as a birth date: typed fields are faster.

Instead:

- [Date picker](./date-picker.md): A calendar opened from a field, in a popover.
- [Input](./input.md): A known date typed in.

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between days; Page Up and Page Down change month. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a grid; the selected and today's dates are announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add calendar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Calendar reads 31 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Calendar's tokens to change Calendar alone.
